description: 0.005 USDC per call via x402, no key (unpaid call returns PaymentRequired; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Advisory pre-sign check (your wallet's own hard limits still apply; we cannot block a payment): 'would this payment exceed my cap?'. Pass the 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED (header or body) or amountUsd, plus payer and optional sessionId/host. Returns allow|deny with reasons and remaining budget; reserve:true also logs it as pending. Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.

amountUsd.description: USD amount as decimal string, e.g. "0.25".

apiKey.description: Your MoneyTools Settle key mts_… (alternative to the X-API-Key header). No key: call settle_trial_key.

paymentRequired.description: The 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64) or the 402 JSON body.

reserve.description: true = log this payment as pending if allowed.
